title: HoloCity GLB Manifest
description: Written by Unity to glb/manifest.json inside a bundle. Maps each exported prefab to its GLB and a content hash, so a re-export skips prefabs whose content has not changed. Re-exporting every GLB on every run costs minutes of editor time for a whole town, and a pipeline that costs minutes per iteration stops being used. DELETE THIS FILE TO FORCE A FULL REBUILD.

exporterVersion.description: Identity of the GLB writer itself, mixed into every hash. A manifest whose exporterVersion differs from the running exporter describes GLBs this build would not produce, and is ignored wholesale rather than trusted entry-by-entry.

prefabPath.description: Assets/... path of the source prefab.

glb.description: GLB filename, relative to the glb/ directory.

hash.description: exporterVersion + AssetDatabase.GetAssetDependencyHash(prefabPath). The dependency hash already covers the asset, its importer settings, and its dependency graph, so a retextured material or a reimported FBX invalidates it without anyone enumerating what to watch. An entry is recorded ONLY after a verified non-empty write — caching a failure as done is how a bundle ends up permanently missing a mesh while every later export reports success.
